title: 68M painless jaundice with hepatomegaly: CT CAP redirected, US Abdomen is the cross-exam candidate
note: CT chest abdo pelvis. 68 yo man. Sudden onset painless jaundice. Diabetes on metformin. Occasional discomfort R side, some pallor and jaundice. Liver ~2 cm below costal margin. wt 58
examSitesNote: The only case in this seed where the note names the requested exam, so the requested entry carries a quote. The us_abdomen candidate is the cross-exam behaviour the matrix records as valued (KI-08, gap analysis §4); the engine, not the model, decides what to do with it, and it can only do so once US Abdomen is transcribed (slice 7).

expectedAbsent.weightloss.present: 'wt 58' is a single recorded weight with nothing to compare it to. It is not a statement of weight loss (contract rule 3).
expectedAbsent.weightloss.percent: No usual body weight; not computable.
expectedAbsent.symptom.jaundice: Not in the CT CAP Questionnaire. It is a national-vocabulary concept whose sites are US Abdomen and US Abdomen Paediatric - it becomes answerable when US Abdomen is transcribed, and is the indicator the us_abdomen candidate would be scored on.

provenance.noteProvenance: verbatim from the results matrix, as already encoded in tests/scenarios.mjs
provenance.evaluatorExpectation: CT CAP declined; US Abdomen recommended acutely.
provenance.divergence: Half the expectation is met today and half is not. CT CAP correctly redirects (localising features). The US Abdomen recommendation needs multi-bundle evaluation (slice 3) and a published US Abdomen bundle (slice 7); this ground truth records the candidate so the behaviour is measurable the moment both exist.
provenance.quoteCorrection: tests/scenarios.mjs records this indicator's quote as 'painless jaundice ... Liver ~2 cm below costal margin' - two spans joined by an ellipsis, which is NOT a verbatim span of the note and would be rejected by gate rule 1. The ground truth uses the shortest single verbatim span that supports the answer: 'Liver ~2 cm below costal margin'. The scenario file is unchanged (out of this brief's scope); see manifest.json findings F-GT-01.
